signup.title: Create your account
signup.name: Your name
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
signup.checkEmailBody: If this address can be used, we have sent a link to confirm it. The link is valid for 24 hours.

login.title: Log in
login.noAccount: New to Inmolink? Create an account
login.verified: Your email is confirmed. You can log in now.
login.resetDone: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new one.
login.joined: Welcome to the team. Log in with your email and the password you just chose.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: Enter the password you chose when you signed up.
verify.failed: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Log in to request a new one, or sign up again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, we have sent a reset link. It is valid for 60 minutes.

invite.title: Join your team on Inmolink
invite.body: Choose the name your colleagues will see and a password for your account.
invite.name: Your name

home.title: Dashboard
home.apiOk: API session check passed for user {userId}.
home.agencyPending: {agency} is waiting for verification. You can set things up now; sharing listings with the network, publishing and website API keys unlock once our team has verified your company.

errors.emailNotVerified: Please confirm your email first. We have sent you a new link.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link is invalid, has already been used or has expired.
errors.verifyPassword: That password does not match this account. If you did not create it, sign up again or reset your password.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.inviteEmailInUse: This email already has an Inmolink account, and an account belongs to one agency. Ask your admin to invite another email address, or contact support.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Inmolink
verify.body: Please confirm your email address to finish creating your Inmolink account. This link is valid for 24 hours.
verify.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Inmolink password
reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. This link is valid for 60 minutes and can be used once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays the same.

exists.subject: You already have an Inmolink account
exists.body: Someone tried to create an Inmolink account with this email address, but an account already exists. You can log in, or reset your password if you have forgotten it.
exists.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

invite.subject: {inviter} invited you to join {agency} on Inmolink
invite.body: {inviter} has invited you to join {agency} on Inmolink. Open the link to choose your name and password. The link is valid for 7 days and can be used once.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
